mapper.insert: insert ignore into t_article_collect (articleId, userId, createTime) values (#{articleId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{userId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, now())
mapper.select: select u.id as u_id, u.avatarUrl as u_avatarUrl, u.nickname as u_nickname, b.id as b_id, b.name as b_name, a.id, a.boardId, a.userId, a.title, a.visitCount, a.replyCount, a.likeCount, a.topState, a.essenceState, a.state, a.createTime, a.updateTime, c.createTime as collectTime from t_article_collect c inner join t_article a on c.articleId = a.id left join t_user u on a.userId = u.id left join t_board b on a.boardId = b.id where c.userId = #{userId,jdbcType=BIGINT} and a.deleteState = 0 and a.state = 0 and b.deleteState = 0 order by c.createTime desc limit #{offset,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{limit,jdbcType=INTEGER}

select count(1) from t_article_collect c inner join t_article a on c.articleId = a.id inner join t_board b on a.boardId = b.id where c.userId = #{userId,jdbcType=BIGINT} and a.deleteState = 0 and a.state = 0 and b.deleteState = 0
